bell.label: Notifications
bell.title: Notifications
bell.empty: Nothing yet. Finished automations, downloads, and anything that needs you will show up here.

destinations.title: Email, push, and webhooks
destinations.description: Send notifications to your email, to your phone or computer with ntfy, or to a service you run. Every notification is still in the bell. A delivery that fails is tried again after 1, 5, and 30 minutes, without running the task again.
destinations.confirmSecret: Make a new signing secret? The old one stops working at once.
destinations.confirmRemove: Remove “{{name}}”? Notifications waiting for it are not sent.
destinations.secretOnce: Signing secret, shown this once. Use it to check the Yggdrasil-Signature header:
destinations.name: Name
destinations.ntfyIntro: Install the ntfy app (Android, iPhone, or ntfy.sh in a browser) and subscribe to the topic below. ntfy is free and open source; you can also run your own ntfy server.
destinations.stored: Stored. Leave blank to keep it.
destinations.onlyIfNeeded: Only if your topic needs one
destinations.contentAuto: Automatic (private on ntfy.sh, full on your own server)
destinations.contentPrivate: Only “You have a new Yggdrasil notification”
destinations.ntfyPublic: On ntfy.sh anyone who knows the topic can read it, so keep the random topic or send only the private notice.
destinations.webhookHint: HTTPS, or HTTP on this computer or your local network. Each request is signed; the secret is shown once after you add it.

quiet.title: Quiet hours
quiet.description: Desktop notices, email, push, and webhooks wait until quiet hours end. They are in the bell at once.
